sloka: दान्तका राजताः चैव गवाक्षाः प्रिय दर्शनाः ।हेम जाला आवृताः च आसन् तत्र प्रासाद पंक्तयः ॥३-५५-१०॥
transliteration: dāntakā rājatāḥ caiva gavākṣāḥ priya darśanāḥ ।hema jālā āvṛtāḥ ca āsan tatra prāsāda paṁktayaḥ ॥3-55-10॥

translations.english: He ascended the wonderful golden staircase taking Sita along with him.Beautiful looked the rows of mansions with silver and ivory windows and golden trellis.
